newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui soon to meet Governor James Soong, but Soong remains firm in intent to resign.
Interior Ministry to offer 7.7 percent low-cost mortgages for public housing.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Vice-President Lien Chan leaves for Nicaragua, set to visit Vatican on the way back.
Provincial government personnel to be transferred to other relevant positions after provincial government is frozen.
LIBERTY TIMES - Lien Chan to visit Europe before returning home from an official visit to Nicaragua.
Provincial government personnel to stay in current posts until December 20, 1998.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Opposition parties criticise ruling Nationalist Party's alleged involvement in bidding of high-speed railway.
Import amounts show negative growth for the first time in 11 years.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Thirty-one securities brokerages fined T$600 million for evading taxes.
More than 30 business leaders accompany Lien Chan to visit Nicaragua in bid to boost ties.
